source: Research compilation (apple_power.json and m4max14.json, 2026-11-21). Desktops: Apple support pages 103253 (Mac mini) and 102027 (Mac Studio), published 21 September 2026, idle and maximum wall power; sleep and off from the Product Environmental Report (PER). Laptops: PER power table, 115 V column (idle with the display on, sleep, off), with the 230 V column kept; adapter and battery from the tech-specs page. Clusters and power modes have no Apple figure and are left out.

machines.notes: PER: table "MacBook Air (M1, 2020)"; tested with 30W adapter. Power figures are the 115 V column; 100 V and 230 V in v100/v230.
